title: History transition bypasses device history approval
reasoning: The history transition permits an admin to change an existing device's history flag from false to true without a proposal or votes. The separate history_activate transition requires quorum approval for that same change. An admin can therefore sign a history transition that grants a future-only device access to historical data without the required approval.
reproduction: Given a valid team workspace state with a future-only device, sign a history transition as an admin with that device's history flag changed to true and otherwise unchanged policy. verify_state accepts it without votes.
recommendation: Prevent history transitions from activating device history; require the history_activate transition and its approval checks for false-to-true changes.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included in the review context.
suggestedRegressionTest: Assert that an admin-signed history transition enabling a future-only device is rejected, while an equivalent history_activate transition succeeds only with the required votes.
minimumFixScope: Restrict device history changes in verify_state's history branch.

history.note: Duplicate unreproduced security hypothesis outside this change; raised for separate assessment.
